negative_findings.description: No single consolidated public register of current supervisory-board and management-board members across all five state banks was found. The composition has to be reconstructed by joining MoF/Cabinet acts, NBU approvals, issuer disclosures and each bank's own corporate-governance page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Composition data exists but is fragmented across at least four publishers; NBU's /bank_managers/ path is the most promising single candidate but its structure was not inspected.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any appointments tracker for this cell needs an entity-resolution and reconciliation layer, not a single feed; budget for that in the collector design.

negative_findings.description: Sense Bank is governed differently from the other four (nationalised via the Deposit Guarantee Fund, with boards appointed on MoF proposals and NBU approval), and no MoF/Cabinet competitive-selection announcement pattern for Sense Bank was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Sense Bank leadership change surfaced only through media (kurs.com.ua, RBC, UNIAN, Glavcom) and through Cabinet decisions reported second-hand, not through a discoverable primary vacancy-notice channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For Sense Bank the collection design will lean on media tripwires plus the Cabinet act feed; expect lower precision and slower confirmation than for Oschadbank/Ukreximbank.

negative_findings.description: No 'Clarity Project' equivalent for officer-change monitoring was confirmed. The search for it returned only Opendatabot and YouControl; the tool exists mainly for procurement rather than personnel, so it was not recorded as a candidate.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search explicitly returned that results contained no information about a Clarity Project in this context.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a fabricated entry; procurement-side registries should be scouted separately if org-change signals from spending are wanted.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated recruitment/careers channel of the state banks (bank career portals, or job boards such as work.ua / robota.ua) was scouted in this pass for senior-hiring or org-restructuring signals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Scope was consumed by governance-appointment channels; no career-portal candidate was verified, so none is listed rather than guessed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'jobs/hiring' topic of the run is currently covered only at board level; mid-level hiring surges are a leading indicator of org change and remain unobserved for this cell.

negative_findings.description: The Oschadbank news/press listing URL was inferred from the bank's domain rather than confirmed from a listing page in the result set, and NBU's /bank_managers/ page structure was not inspected.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are recorded with reduced confidence scores and empty example_urls where no concrete item URL was actually observed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic liveness pass must resolve these two paths before they enter a scheduled crawl.

coverage_gaps.description: Executive-search / headhunting firms engaged by MoF and by the banks' supervisory boards (the Oschadbank CEO competition explicitly used international recruiters, and MoF ran a tender for an executive-search company for Ukreximbank) were not identified by name.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the MoF executive-search tender announcements and any Prozorro award records to name the search firms, then track those firms' own mandate announcements as an early-warning channel.

coverage_gaps.description: IFI/donor-side sources (EBRD, IFC, EU, IMF structural benchmarks on SOE corporate governance) were not scouted, although IFIs nominate or vet independent board members and IMF programme documents set dated conditionality on state-bank governance.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout IMF country-report structural benchmarks, EBRD/IFC press releases and EU Ukraine Facility reporting for dated commitments on state-bank board reform.

coverage_gaps.description: Professional-network and first-person channels (LinkedIn profiles of state-bank executives, their public posts announcing moves) were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess LinkedIn as a controlled, ToS-compliant enrichment channel for confirming effective start dates and departures; do not scrape.

coverage_gaps.description: Annual reports, corporate-governance reports and audited financial statements of the five banks — which contain the authoritative year-end board rosters, committee composition, attendance and organisational charts — were not systematically located beyond one Ukrgasbank org-structure PDF.

brief: Leadership change at Ukraine's state banks is unusually well documented because three separate bodies have a publication duty over the same event: the Ministry of Finance and the Cabinet publish the competitive-selection announcement and the appointment act, the NBU publishes the fit-and-proper approval that makes it effective, and each bank files an 'особлива інформація' officer-change disclosure with the NSSMC. A robust tracker for this cell should treat MoF/Cabinet as the earliest datable signal, NBU as the confirmation gate, and the NSSMC issuer-disclosure XML as the structured system of record, with the banks' own press centres supplying names, biographies and the management-board layer that the state feeds omit. Media aggregators (minfin.com.ua, Ukrinform, Forbes.ua, Interfax, RBC, kurs.com.ua) are best used as tripwires and as the only practical coverage of contested or scandal-driven exits, notably at Sense Bank, whose DGF/MoF governance route lacks the public vacancy-notice channel the other four have. The main structural weakness is that no consolidated roster of current board members exists, so composition must be reconstructed by joining these feeds, and annual/corporate-governance reports plus executive-search firms remain unscouted.
